text:
Aisha: Quick capture from Clearbay onboarding call at 11:10 — pulsing up asks for product triage. Short list below.

Aisha: Main asks: 1) per-route cost breakdown in Console (customer wants CSV export + per-deployment filter). 2) embedding staleness alert — their retriever notices stale embeddings after weekly reindex. 3) webhook for onboarding events (model-ready, index-done) to automate post-onboard checks.

Tom: thanks — adding to feature triage board. Can you paste exact CSV columns they expect?

Aisha: they want: route_id, model_name, tokens_in, tokens_out, cost_estimate, timestamp. Also asked for per-user cost estimate if we can infer. Snippet they sent:
```
route_id,model,tokens_in,tokens_out,cost_usd,timestamp
route_123,gpt-4o-mini,120,430,0.013,2026-03-10T14:22Z
```

Priya: Noted embedding staleness. Do we have current signal for embedding drift? I can run quick eval across last 3 indices.

Jordi: prioritization idea: classify asks into "Onboarding automation" (webhook + CSV export) vs "Quality" (staleness alert). Proposal: treat automation as P2 (fast wins) and staleness as P1 if retriever failures > 5% on critical queries. Thoughts?

Aisha: agree — Clearbay reported 8% retrieval hit drop. Mark staleness as P1. I'll surface a short repro set to product.

feedback-bot: New note added to CS->Product board by Aisha: "Clearbay onboarding: per-route CSV export + embedding staleness alert + onboarding webhooks" :ticket: 2345

Tom: I'll pick up the CSV export spec for the sprint and sync with infra on export quota. Can someone own the repro set for staleness?

Priya: I'll collect the repro queries and run a quick drift scan by EOD. Aisha, can you link the onboarding logs?

Aisha: Linking log sample here: https://redwood-infra/clearbay/onboard/logs/abc123 (internal)

Jordi: Great — plan: Priya runs drift scan, Aisha uploads repro + logs, Tom builds CSV spec, I'll slot staleness alert into next planning. PRs to follow. :thumbsup:

Aisha: Thanks team — will update this thread when attachments uploaded.
